days.title: The Waiting Is Not Wasted
days.scripture_text: Expect the Lord, do manfully, and let thy heart take courage, and wait thou for the Lord.
days.prayer: Lord, You know the desire of my heart before I speak it. Teach me to spend this season of waiting well — not pacing at the door, but preparing the house. Make me, day by day, into someone capable of the love I am asking You for. Amen.

days.title: What You Practice, You Become
days.scripture_text: He that is faithful in that which is least, is faithful also in that which is greater.
days.prayer: Jesus, the habits I keep today are the marriage I will bring tomorrow. Help me practice faithfulness in small, unseen things — my word, my time, my attention — so that faithfulness in great things comes naturally. Amen.

days.closing: Lord, make me faithful in the least.

days.title: The Ache Is Allowed
days.scripture_text: Lord, all my desire is before thee, and my groaning is not hidden from thee.
days.prayer: Father, I will not pretend this doesn't hurt sometimes. The empty seat, the quiet apartment, the wedding invitations. I bring You the ache instead of numbing it. Sit with me in it, and let it soften me rather than harden me. Amen.
